partner_result.applied_scope: lossless reduction from arbitrary independent densities <=1 to finite-union unit-measure indicator inputs, preserving the small-ball constant

new_result.statement: If an original-coordinate 2x2 principal block B of A is definite with Delta=det(B)>0, then ||p_{X^T A X}||_infinity <= pi/sqrt(Delta) for arbitrary independent coordinate densities <=1, uniformly in supports, translations, all other entries and all remaining eigenvalues.

unresolved_implication: Close the complementary target class where every definite physical 2x2 principal minor is absent or too small for a dimension-free reciprocal-determinant bound; likely requires heavy/diffuse/hyperbolic aggregation rather than local-minor inversion.
